description: Concrete, actionable development/release notes that are useful to developers but are not gameplay BUG or DESIGN_MISMATCH findings.

notes.title: Version Name Is Inconsistent
notes.problem: The project registry identifies Builder's Memory / BlitzBuild as version 1.0.3, while the selected current World File is named BlitzBuild-v1.0.2.mcworld.
notes.action: Align the release version across the project registry and delivered World File naming so developers and testers can identify the current build reliably.

notes.title: Version Name Is Inconsistent
notes.problem: The project registry identifies Five Nights at Z Village Level 2 as version 1.2.2, while the selected current World File is named Defense_Level_2_v1_2_0.mcworld.
notes.action: Align the delivered World File name with the current release version and map identity so developers and testers can identify the correct build reliably.

notes.title: Show Incoming Wave Count During Fortify Preparation
notes.problem: Fortify already calculates the wave size and shows remaining kills during combat, but the build/preparation HUD does not show how many enemies are about to arrive. Loadout Trial already exposes its threat count in the preview HUD.
notes.action: Add a persistent 'Incoming: N enemies' line during Fortify kit/build preparation so the player can size the defense before deployment. Reuse getFortifyWaveSize(a.tier); do not create a second wave-count authority.

evidence.finding: Fortify _showHud computes waveSize but omits it from SELECTION/BUILD status; Loadout Trial PREVIEW already shows tier.threatLabel such as '4x T2 Militia'.

notes.title: Show Which Block an NPC Is Breaking
notes.problem: NPC path breaking currently plays an attack animation on the entity and removes the target block only when the break timer completes. The player receives no block-target progress cue showing which block is being attacked.
notes.action: Add player-visible target/progress feedback for the block under attack (for example a crack/progress effect or equivalent supported visual), driven from the existing break state so it cannot disagree with the authoritative target or timer.

evidence.finding: LastStandPathObstructionService._tickBreaking only triggers entity.playAnimation(); _completeBreak later sets the target block to air. No target-block progress feedback is emitted.

notes.title: Anti-Cheat Protection Is Not Registered in Production
notes.problem: AntiCheatManager defines Creative/Spectator correction for non-admin players, but production main.js never imports or instantiates it, so those subscriptions are inactive.
notes.action: Either register AntiCheatManager from the production bootstrap if the protection is required, or remove the dead module and ensure active arena guards own the intended capability policy.

evidence.finding: AntiCheatManager subscribes to playerGameModeChange/playerSpawn, but main.js creates ArenaService, SetupManager, WorldManager, EventCommandManager, HologramManager and WelcomeManager only.

admissionRule: DEV_NOTE requires concrete evidence, clear developer value, an actionable correction, and must not be speculative.
